Kaavakuva: energialajit esimerkein. Meka: Schematic diagram: forms of energy with examples. Mechanical energy is potential energy (a ball at the edge of a cliff) and kinetic energy (a rolling ball). The picture also shows thermal energy (a hot coffee cup), chemical energy (a battery), radiant energy (the Sun), electrical energy (lightning) and nuclear energy (an atomic nucleus). The picture is schematic, not to scale.
Kaavakuva: energian muuttuminen taskulam: Schematic diagram: energy changes in a torch (flashlight). The battery holds chemical energy. It changes into electrical energy, and the bulb changes the electrical energy into light and thermal energy. Most of it changes into thermal energy, so the arrow for thermal energy is wider. The picture is schematic, and the widths of the arrows are not to scale.
Kaavakuva: skeittari half-pipessä kolmel: Schematic diagram: a skateboarder in a half-pipe at three moments, with the energies at each moment as bars. At the start the skateboarder is at rest at the edge, and all the energy, 800 J, is potential energy. In the middle there is 300 J of potential energy, 450 J of kinetic energy and 50 J of thermal energy. At the bottom there is no potential energy, 700 J of kinetic energy and 100 J of thermal energy. The heights of the bars are to scale, and the total height of every bar corresponds to 800 joules, so there is the same amount of energy at every moment.
Kaavakuva ja pylväskaavio: skeittari läh: Schematic diagram and bar chart: a skater starts from rest at point A on the rim of a half-pipe, passes point B on the slope and arrives at point C at the bottom. The half-pipe has friction. At each point the bars show the potential energy and the kinetic energy in joules; the gridlines of the energy axis are 100 J apart. At point A the potential energy is 700 J and the kinetic energy 0 J, at point B the potential energy is 300 J and the kinetic energy 300 J, and at point C the potential energy is 0 J and the kinetic energy 500 J. The figure does not show thermal energy.
